datasheet_id_and_revision: LT6230/LT6230-10/LT6231/LT6232 family data sheet, document code 623012fc, Rev C (1/11) per revision history p23; footer 'LT 0111 REV C'; copyright 2003
datasheet_status: production data sheet as printed (no preliminary marking)
page_numbering: PDF page index equals printed page number (1-24)
type_legend: TYP = typical 25 C; MIN/MAX guaranteed (25 C unless range named); CURVE = vector-path digitization of a typical curve (error < +/-0.2 dB / +/-0.5 deg); SCOPE/PHOTO = read from a raster photo with stated uncertainty
family_note: Tables give part-specific values for the -10 only for GBW, slew rate and FPBW; noise, input, swing and supply entries are family-wide. Curves on p10-14 are labelled LT6230/LT6231/LT6232 (unity-gain parts); p15-16 are LT6230-10.
input_type: bipolar NPN input pair (Q1/Q2) with emitter degeneration, current-mirror load; rail-to-rail output only (p17 Fig. 1)
compensation: decompensated, internal (C_M sets GBW, C1 reduces unity-cross frequency); no external compensation pin (p17)

min_stable_gain.below_minimum: No guidance on operation below A_V = 10, on capacitive (TIA) feedback or noise-gain shaping for the -10.

supply.recommended: specified at 3.3 V, 5 V and +/-5 V; minimum supply 3 V MIN (Note 7, guaranteed by PSRR test)

+/-5 V, 25 C, R_F = 1k, R_G = 100; x = total resistor load including feedback R

phase_margin_or_crossover.value: +/-5 V: |A| = 20 dB at ~50 MHz with 56 deg; 0 dB crossover ~255 MHz with ~8 deg. 3 V: 20 dB at ~40 MHz (~52 deg), 0 dB at ~205 MHz

open_loop_curve.figure: G45 p15 'Open-Loop Gain and Phase vs Frequency' (LT6230-10)
open_loop_curve.conditions: V_S = +/-5 V and 3 V, 0 V; plot legend: A_V = 10, C_L = 5 pF, R_L = 1k, V_CM = V_S/2; temperature not stated
open_loop_curve.phase_convention: right axis PHASE (DEG) from -80 to 120; plotted phase falls from ~115-120 deg at 100 kHz to ~0 near the 0 dB crossover, i.e. read as 180 deg + arg(A_OL) like the LT6200 plots; values above 90 deg at low frequency are not explained in the data sheet. Both phase curves turn upward above ~300-400 MHz (gain already below 0 dB).
open_loop_curve.digitization: vector paths; gridline calibration; gain curves end at -10 dB (axis floor) near 4.2e8 (+/-5 V) and 3.4e8 Hz (3 V)

open_loop_output_impedance.note: Not given. Closed-loop output impedance (G22 p12) is for the unity-gain LT6230 family only (A_V = 1, 2, 10; 5 V): roughly 0.1-0.4 ohm at 100 kHz rising to a 40-70 ohm peak near 20-40 MHz (eye, +/-20%).

packages.name: S6, 6-lead plastic TSOT-23 (ThinSOT)
packages.notes: only package for LT6230/LT6230-10; order LT6230CS6-10 / LT6230IS6-10, marking LTAFK; T_JMAX 150 C

pinout_notes: S6: 1 OUT, 2 V-, 3 +IN, 4 -IN, 5 ENABLE (active low), 6 V+. ENABLE must be driven low (<= 0.3 V) to operate; high within 0.35 V of V+ shuts down to < 10 uA (p18); ENABLE pin current -25 TYP / -75 MAX uA at 0.3 V; t_ON 300 ns, t_OFF 41 us (p4).

tia_content.what: p24 'Low Power Avalanche Photodiode Transimpedance Amplifier' with the unity-gain LT6230 (not -10), +/-5 V, I_S = 3.3 mA; APD (Advanced Photonix 012-70-62-541) cathode biased at ~200 V; R2 = 1.5k || C2 = 0.1 uF from +IN to ground for bias-current cancellation
tia_content.bandwidth: 20 MHz (17 ns rise time from scope photo)
tia_content.measured_or_simulated: measured (scope photo, output noise 1.1 mV_pp in 100 MHz BW)

tia_content.what: Text p24: 1.5k resistor noise 5 nV/rtHz or 3.4 pA/rtHz vs amplifier 1.1 nV/rtHz and 2.4 pA/rtHz; output offset 'measured at 280 uV' in text but '500 uV typical' in the figure note

application_guidance: Noise equals a 75 ohm resistor: keep R_S + R_G||R_F <= 75 ohm; resistor noise dominates 75 ohm-3 kohm, current noise above ~3 kohm; e_n x sqrt(I_SUPPLY) = 1.9 (p18). Back-to-back input diodes, no internal series resistors; 100 ohm in series would raise noise 1.1 -> 2.1 nV/rtHz; limit diode current to 40 mA (25 ohm per volt beyond 0.7 V) (p17). With A_V >= 2 the output can phase-invert under very heavy overdrive: keep inputs within 0.5 V beyond the rails (p18). Capacitive load (G44 p15, 5 V, A_V = 10): ~32-36% overshoot at 10 pF for R_S = 10-50 ohm (eye).
abs_max_and_input_protection: Total supply 12.6 V; input current +/-40 mA (Note 2); output short-circuit indefinite (Note 3); T_J 150 C; operating -40 to 85 C; storage -65 to 150 C; ESD diodes to the rails tolerate transient currents up to 100 mA (p2, p18).
other_notes: Table/curve consistency: G46 GBW 1287 MHz at 5 V and 1453 MHz at 10 V match the table (1300 / 1450).
Possible typos: p6 V_OL row 'V_S = 5V, I_SINK = 15mA' where other tables use 20 mA; p6 V_OH row cites Note 6 instead of Note 8; p24 offset 280 uV (text) vs 500 uV (figure).
HF noise photo G55 (hump to ~5.3 nV/rtHz at 20 MHz) has no stated conditions; unexplained by the data sheet.
